title: Chronicle Journal Amend v1
description: Request/response for serve PATCH /journal/entries/{id}. The amend gate requires the on-disk fence body hash to equal both filed_content_hash and the client-supplied base_hash; mismatch returns HTTP 409 with {detail, on_disk_hash, filed_content_hash}.

body.description: New fence body (raw markdown between the entry fences, without the fence comment lines)

base_hash.description: SHA-256 of the fence body the client based its edit on; must match on-disk hash and filed_content_hash

hash.description: SHA-256 of the new fence body; also written to the entry's filed_content_hash
